matched_candidate.label: MTP only, chunk 4096, experimental QSA OFF

limits: One artificial source-review workload, 33475 tokens, 64 generated IDs. Only 2048/4096 controls, MTP-only 4096 and both-on 4096 repeated twice. No statistically broad speed/quality claim.
QSA-enabled 4096 runs diverge reproducibly at output ID index 42. CPU operator tolerance passing is NOT whole-model token parity; do not recommend this combination as token-consistent.
All measured cold arms have zero reuse, refill and expert streaming. This does not model the more constrained IQ3_S deployment.
Model token consistency is sampled, not complete logits/CPU-model parity, MI60, full 262K context or a long soak.
Checkpoint probes reuse 16384 tokens and compare three followup IDs, not multi-conversation RAM parking/full state parity.
GPU phase percentages include waits/idle; host and GPU intervals overlap, and stage wall times are not additive.
Private driver corrected close() clearing proc and waited boundedly for deferred VRAM release. The initial unverified-exit control was excluded.

Original 8082/configs/binary/launchers were not changed or restarted. Own test engines were unloaded. Raw inputs/fixtures, harness stdout and engine stderr stay private; engine stdout was retained as generated IDs/DONE metrics, not a complete raw pipe transcript.
